passage: The archive acquired three new ______ a map, a ledger, and a set of letters.

passage: The newly restored painting, unlike the two sketches beside ______ attracted a steady crowd.

passage: Although the first rehearsal ran ______ the musicians finished the full program.

passage: The clock’s mechanism had one obvious ______ a missing gear.

passage: The revised map shows the old canal, which no longer carries ______ and the new pedestrian route.

passage: Because the hall was ______ the choir rehearsed outdoors.

passage: The editor reviewed the manuscript and ______ the illustrations before sending both to the printer.

passage: The manuscript’s final page contains a surprising ______ the narrator has been addressing her future self.

passage: The river rose ______ the morning market opened on schedule.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

passage: The two winning designs—one made of timber and the other of recycled ______ will be displayed in the foyer.

passage: The committee approved the revised plan, which included wider paths and clearer ______ it postponed the lighting proposal until next month.

passage: Before the exhibition ______ the curator checked every label.

passage: One question remained after the final ______ who would maintain the garden?

passage: Neither the printed guide nor the online maps ______ the temporary closure.
